visualRegions.description: Complete bright hospital pharmacy with shelves, dispensing counter, automated cabinet, cart and compounding bench
Glass medicine shelves with boxes, bottles, blister packs and stock trays across the left wall
Long dispensing counter with prescription baskets, pill trays, printer and service window
Automated dispensing cabinet and medicine refrigerator with drawers, bays and cold storage on the right wall
Stainless rolling cart with supply baskets, medicine bins, vial rack and blue lower tray in the foreground
Compounding bench with scale, mixing bowl, measuring cylinder, spatula, sink and waste bin
